pandas.Period.asfreq

pandas 3.1.1 · Arrays, scalars, and data types · method

Conform the object to a frequency. Use resample to aggregate observations into time bins.

  • Call syntax
  • Run the example
  • Parameters
  • Returns

Call syntax

Period.asfreq(freq, how='E')
